# Zeffy

> Zeffy is a 100% free fundraising platform trusted by 50,000+ nonprofits, offering integrated tools for donations, events, memberships, and donor management without transaction fees.

Zeffy provides comprehensive nonprofit fundraising software with zero fees, supporting multiple revenue channels including online donations, event ticketing, peer-to-peer campaigns, auctions, raffles, memberships, and direct mail. The platform eliminates payment processing costs through partnerships with Apple Pay, Google Pay, and ACH, enabling nonprofits to retain more funds.

## Key Topics

- 100% free fundraising platform
- Zero transaction fees
- Nonprofit fundraising
- Payment processing (Apple Pay, Google Pay, ACH)
- Donation platform
- Event ticketing & registration
- Peer-to-peer fundraising
- Donor management software
- Membership management
- Email marketing for nonprofits
- Online auction software
- Raffle platform
- POS system for nonprofits
- Direct mail service
- Pricing comparison vs competitors

## Core Platform & Features

- [Zeffy | 100% Free Fundraising Software](https://www.zeffy.com): Zeffy homepage: 100% free fundraising platform trusted by 50,000+ nonprofits.
- [How is Zeffy 100% Free? | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/free-online-fundraising-platform): Explains Zeffy's free model and business approach with customer testimonials.
- [Free Donation Website for Nonprofits | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/online-donation-platform-nonprofits): Free donation platform with recurring giving and automatic tax receipts.
- [Free Donor Management Software | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/donor-management): Free donor database and management software for nonprofit engagement.
- [Free Email Marketing Software for Nonprofits | Zeffy - 100% Free](https://www.zeffy.com/home/newsletter-emailing): Unlimited free email marketing for nonprofits with campaign tracking.

## Event & Ticketing Solutions

- [Event Ticketing & Registration Software for Nonprofits | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/ticketing-system-fundraising-events): 100% free event ticketing and registration platform for nonprofit fundraising.
- [Free POS for Nonprofits | Tap to Pay | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/tap-to-pay): Free iPhone POS app for in-person payments and ticket sales.
- [100% Free Auction Software For Your Nonprofit | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/auction): Free online auction platform for nonprofits with bidding system.
- [Free Online Raffle Platform for Nonprofits | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/online-raffle-nonprofit): Free raffle platform for selling numbered tickets online and in-person.

## Membership & Commerce Tools

- [Free Membership Management Software for Nonprofits | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/membership-application-form-nonprofits-associations): Free membership management with forms, renewals, cards, and tax receipts.
- [Free Online Store and eCommerce Platform for Nonprofits | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/online-store-for-nonprofits): Free eCommerce store for nonprofits with inventory and payment processing.
- [Free Peer-to-Peer Fundraising Platform | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/product-peer-to-peer-campaign): Free peer-to-peer fundraising with multi-level campaigns and donor engagement.
- [Nonprofit Direct Mail — Send Donor Letters for $1 | Zeffy](https://www.zeffy.com/home/donor-mail): Direct mail service at $1/letter with printing, postage, and QR tracking.
